turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or filter for ad spend restricted to days when another metric (email bookings) was zero, so I cannot give that figure; the closest metrics are ad_spend_eur and bookings by campaign__channel and day. For reference, total ad spend across all channels from 17 August to 2 October 2026 was 9,555.00 EUR, and email had bookings on only four of those days (21 Aug, 2 Sep, 14 Sep, 26 Sep). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
